about_the_game:
Double, double, tilt and tumble; Bread may burn, but cookies crumble.

Serve up a slice of late 2000's app store nostalgia with this short-but-sweet gravity-altering physics-based 2D ball-rolling game. Now available to-go on Steam Deck!

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master


Tilt each stage left and right to navigate the treat to the end. Each stage can be beaten at your own pace in 30 seconds or less, but don't be fooled - you'll need cookie-cutter precision to beat the hardest clear times and earn all all 3 Hearts.

Every Flavor under the Sun


From cannons to conveyor belts, to bouncy jelly, slippery ice, zero-g static, and surprisingly nice looking water, each recipe has a unique twist to keep you on your toes. Use them to your advantage to shave seconds off your time.

Earn Dough for Sweet Treats


Spend those hard-earned hearts on some cute, some curious, all of them color-less but definitely not class-less, custom-tailored cosmetics to add a little bit of your own personal flavor.

No Decaf Here


Speed is the name of the game in the restaurant business. Mess up? Hit the reset button and be right back at the start in less than a second. Progress and records are saved as you go, so even if your PC takes a spill mid-stage, you'll be able to pick right back up where you left off.

Some Sugar on Top


Take a break from the action with some unlockable mini-games. Be prepared though - we've added some special seasoning from the main game that might make them taste a little different from what you're used to.

Keep on Rolling

Our menu is constantly expanding with new cosmetics, stages, modes and mini-games. No need to rush though - our seasonal offerings are always available all year round.




The game tastes best when served with a controller or device that has gyroscopic capabilities, but it is perfectly playable with touch or a standard mouse and keyboard.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS Holo 3.6+
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Embedded should work
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any that support MP3 streaming (most CPUs have this embedded)
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Steam Deck. Requires Steam Runtime 3.0 (Sniper)
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS Holo 3.6+
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated graphics card.
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No additional specialized support for dedicated sound cards.
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Linux version may be more CPU-bound than Windows version due to differences in display stacks.

name: Crescent Roll

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 700 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Embedded should work.
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any that support MP3 streaming (most CPUs have this embedded)
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Best with something that has a gyro, but works without it.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated graphics card.
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: No additional specialized support for dedicated sound cards.
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Physics calculations in later stages may be a bit taxing on older (pre-2015) devices.
